title: Knowledge
description: What Leo knows in {workspace}. It answers each person only from what they can use: knowledge for everyone, and their own teams’.

alwaysIncluded.text: Leo also answers from the meetings, decisions and projects each person can open here. Nobody has to add them.
alwaysIncluded.label: Always included

empty.title: No files or sources yet
empty.text: Share your own files (they stay yours), upload files that belong to {workspace}, or connect a shared drive or wiki. Leo answers from them for whoever can use them.

sections.sourcesEmptyAdmin: Connect the drive or wiki your team already uses, and Leo keeps up with it.
sections.sourcesEmpty: Admins can connect the drive or wiki your team already uses.

access.hint: Leo answers from it only for them. You can change this later.

remove.disconnectText: Syncing stops and Leo stops answering from it. Nothing changes in {provider}.
remove.removeText: It’s deleted from {workspace}, and Leo stops answering from it for everyone.
